      How scoring works

      • Rounds are 2-minute windows on the clock. Pick Squeek or Sleep while the countdown runs; your pick counts for the round that starts when it hits zero.
      • When that round starts, this page records whether the wheel is running or stopped. It settles after 2 minutes, or as soon as the wheel changes state.
      • Call a change correctly (asleep to running, or running to asleep) for 3 points. Call no change correctly for 1 point. A wrong pick costs nothing.
      • Rounds are read in your browser, so keep the page open. A round with no reading at its start or end is not scored.

      Squeek or Sleep reads live wheel telemetry from the public Squeekchain API every 5 seconds. No tokens, no wallet, no sign-up. Visit squeekchain.com
